_comment: The town hub's buildings (scripts/data/town.gd). Times in minutes, money in Pokédollars, coins are Game Corner coins.

energy._comment: Each Pokémon line has max pips; every match uses one. With energy left a match pays rested_mult XP and money; at zero the line is tired and pays tired_mult (it still fights normally). Pips come back by themselves every regen_minutes, every center_minutes while resting at the Pokémon Center, and one for every match you play with someone else while it rests there. Trainers with fewer than min_lines unlocked lines never get tired.

daycare._comment: The Pokémon left at the Day Care gets share of the XP you earn with others. A second spot costs second_slot_price.

drinks._comment: Celadon Department Store rooftop. One drink per match, picked before it starts and used up.

lemonade.name: Lemonade
lemonade.desc: Super charges 25% faster for one match

tm_counter._comment: Department Store TM counter: this many TMs you don't have, picked each day.

game_corner._comment: Coins: bought with Pokédollars (up to buy_cap a day) or earned in matches. Slots pay bet x payout for three of a kind; cherries pay on their own.

voltorb_flip._comment: Per level: how many 2s, 3s and Voltorbs on the 5x5 board. Clearing moves you up a level, hitting a Voltorb drops you to the number of tiles you flipped (at most your level).

trainers._comment: Trainers wandering round town: per_slot of them, a new set every slot_hours. Stars set their level bonus over yours, HP and how much they bet. Stakes: what you may bet against each star level (0 = a friendly match). Win: your stake back twice plus bonus_per_star x stars. Lose: the stake is gone. Draw: refunded. Lose loss_streak wagers in a row and stakes are capped at the lowest for cooloff_minutes.

tower._comment: Trainer Tower in the Battle Arena: floor after floor of trainers. Losing sends you back to the last checkpoint (every checkpoint floors). First clear of a floor pays money_base + money_step x floor; ball_floors give a ball the first time.
